notes: Faebloom Trick, printed: 'Create two 1/1 blue Faerie creature tokens with flying. When you do, tap target creature an opponent controls.' Seat 1 controls two untapped creatures and seat 0 one of its own. Resolving creates exactly two 1/1 flying Faerie tokens; then the reflexive trigger goes on the stack and its target is chosen from the opponent's creatures only (seat 0 picks the first): that one is tapped. The opponent's other creature and seat 0's own creature stay untapped.
